author: Gert Marginet
name: CAT message handler
description: The handler of a message that the service receives, with its test. The name is the name of the message type. Add a Receive of the message to the event processor. Run it in the folder of the solution of a service.

ServiceName.description: The full name of the service, such as Contoso.Shop.Orders.

Tests.description: Add the test. Use false for a service without the project ServiceName.CoreService.Tests.

MessageNamespace.description: The namespace of the message type. The default is the namespace of the messages in the Contracts project of the service.
